description: Changes an Asana task's completion, assignee, due date or name, or appends to its notes (does not replace them). Cannot change custom fields. Refuses on a lead whose portal-link email is pending. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

append_notes.description: Text appended to the end of the description. Does not replace the existing description.

assignee_email.description: New assignee's email; the address belongs to a member of the firm's Asana.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

due_on.description: New due date, YYYY-MM-DD, or null to clear.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

task_id.description: Asana task id from list_matter_tasks, search_tasks or get_task.

name: update_task
title: Update Asana task
